The logo: the words on one wave with the cards

Holger, 28 Sep, with a sketch: the wavy one is better, but can it feel even more like a wave; if you drew a helping line through the cards and the text, would that help it feel more connected, part of the same wave? So: the two lines on one sine that leaves the front card’s corner at the card’s own lean and runs back along its top edge, inside a band as tall as the card, five ways: the trough at the middle, the helping lines drawn, the trough later, a deeper wave, the trough earlier. N2 is kept as it was. Then, at his next word, the apps’ characters as the mark: the queen of Pinochle, the jack of Euchre, the queen of Gin Rummy, the king of Rummy and the joker of Canasta, each alone without the cards, read off its Photoshop layer with no shadow, its bottom finished with rounded corners and the black line, facing away from the words, at 1.3 times the fan’s height beside the words of the logo the site uses now. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “O3”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

O The words on one wave with the cards

Holger, with a sketch of two red lines: the wavy one is better, but can it feel even more like a wave; if you drew a helping line through the cards and the text, would that make it feel more connected, part of the same wave? So: a sine leaves the front card’s top-right corner at the card’s own lean, dips to a trough under the words and rises again, and to the left of the corner it runs back along the card’s top edge. Both lines are parallel offsets of that one curve, inside a band as tall as the card, so the band’s top edge is the card’s top edge carried on and its bottom edge the card’s bottom edge carried on. Nothing else changes from N2: the size, the weight, the air between the lines, the starts, the gap to the card. One row draws the helping lines.

O1

One wave

The words on the wave that leaves the card’s corner at the card’s lean, the trough at the middle of the words

The band’s top edge is the front card’s top edge carried on as a sine; World of hangs under it and Card Games sits over the bottom edge, the card’s bottom edge carried on. The wave leaves the corner at ten degrees, dips 18 of the fan’s 100 by the middle of the words, and rises at ten degrees again by their end.

P The apps’ characters as the mark, with today’s logotype

Holger: the character alone, no cards; the bottom with the same black line as the rest of the character; every character facing away from the words; and the character about 30% bigger against the words. So the queen of Pinochle, the jack of Euchre, the queen of Gin Rummy, the king of Rummy and the joker of Canasta each stand in the fan’s place at 1.3 times the fan’s height, their right edge where the fan’s box ended, with today’s outlined Bariol Bold words at today’s size and distance, centred on the mark. Each character is read off its own layer in the app icon’s Photoshop source with psd-tools, without the card layers and without the group’s drop shadow; its white sticker outline is a stroke on its own group and comes with it. The illustrator’s straight cut at the bottom is finished with rounded corners at 7% of the height, the black line at the thickness of the character’s own line art, and the white outline outside it, so the bottom edge reads like every other edge. The jack, the king and the joker face the words as drawn and are mirrored; the two queens face away as drawn.
